title: QuantumFPS
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack designed to maximize your FPS and ensure the smoothest gameplay possible.
body:
## About QuantumFPS
**QuantumFPS** is a next-generation Fabric optimization modpack powered by the **Vulkan API engine** to guarantee maximum frames and zero stuttering. 

### ⚠️ Important Graphics Info
* This modpack completely bypasses traditional OpenGL/Iris rendering.
* It works **exclusively with Beryl shaders**. Standard Iris/OptiFine shaderpacks are **NOT** supported due to Vulkan architecture.

### Features
* Massive FPS boost for low-end and high-end PCs
* Faster world loading and chunk generation
* Optimized memory and network usage
